result.document_summary: Santa Ana city press release announcing adoption of a Rent Stabilization Ordinance and a Just Cause Eviction Ordinance, both effective November 19, 2021.
result.notes: The page names no ordinance chapter numbers, so citations use the page title. Two rules extracted: rent increase cap and just cause eviction. The press release says the rent cap does not apply to buildings constructed after February 1, 1995; this was coded as an exemption on first occupancy date.

rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance annual cap
rules.requirement: Residential rent increases are limited to the lower of 3% per year or 80% of the 12-month CPI change; if CPI is negative, no increase is allowed. Owners may petition for relief to ensure a fair and reasonable return.
rules.key_value: Lower of 3% or 80% of CPI change
rules.citation: Santa Ana City Council adopts rent stabilization and just cause eviction ordinances, effective Nov. 19 - City of Santa Ana (Rent Stabilization Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period.
rules.coverage_text: Residential rental properties in Santa Ana, except buildings constructed after February 1, 1995 (and mobile home spaces first offered for rent after January 1, 1990).
rules.exemptions_text: Residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995, and mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990, are not subject to the cap.

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: After 30 days of tenancy, an owner may not terminate a tenancy without just cause stated in a written notice. For no-fault terminations the owner must provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive the final 3 months of rent.
rules.key_value: 3 months relocation assistance or rent waiver for no-fault terminations
rules.citation: Santa Ana City Council adopts rent stabilization and just cause eviction ordinances, effective Nov. 19 - City of Santa Ana (Just Cause Eviction Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
rules.coverage_text: Residential rentals in Santa Ana, except housing produced in the last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, hotels and transient occupancy, hospitals and care facilities, dormitories, and other shared living quarters.
